“Helaman’s brethren” in the summary are not stated to be present with Helaman in this passage; the passage specifically says the young men wanted Helaman as leader.
The supplied narration's use of “stripling soldiers” and its summary are supported by verse 22, but depiction should not add a battle or unmentioned details of the march.
